newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's August trade surplus $26 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's August trade surplus $26 mln.

text.p: Argentina posted a $26 million trade surplus in August, up from $23 million in August 1995, the Economy Ministry said Friday.
In the January-August period the surplus was $636 million, compared with a $1.18 billion surplus in the same period last year.
Exports in August were $2.29 billion, a 30 percent increase on August 1995, while imports were $2.27 billion, also 30 percent more than in the same month last year.

Earlier in the day, Industry, Trade and Mining Secretary Alieto Guadagni said the government expected to have equilibrium in its 1996 trade balance, with both imports and exports roughly at $27 billion.
